name: Tank General
description:
About This Game

An online card game set in World War II, centered on deckbuilding and battles against opponents. The classic collectible card game formula is expanded with grid movement mechanics, unique gameplay mechanics, and a card and headquarters exploration system.

The game will not contain Pay-to-Win elements, loot boxes, cases, or other donation items. Only exploration of vehicle cards, orders, and headquarters. Any card or headquarters can be explored in-game.

The core feature of the game is that card battles are built around real armored warfare mechanics:

• Light tanks can perform more movement actions;

• Medium tanks have specific movement actions and are also versatile combat units;

• Heavy tanks become defenseless if they attack during their turn, which is compensated by increased survivability and damage;

• PT-SAU destroyers always attack from ambush, allowing them to always inflict damage first;

• SAU can attack any detected target on the battlefield.

In fact, it's a mix of a card game and tank battles.

Game Features:

— 3 nations: USSR, Germany, and USA (more nations will be added in the future);

— About 150 vehicle cards with abilities and over 50 command (spell) cards;

— 27 types of Headquarters (9 per nation) with abilities;

— 1v1 PVP online battle mode (the main game mode);

— Several PVE modes (Historical campaigns, separate "Raid" mode, training battles, training campaign);

— deck manager;

— cards and headquarters research system;

Command the German, American, or Soviet HQs, control legendary tanks, and use their abilities, HQ abilities, and various orders to turn the tide of battle.

Your goal is to win the battle against opponents controlled by both humans and AI (depending on the selected mode).

Fight on the battlefield: Place tanks on the battlefield, use HQ abilities, cards, and orders to strengthen your allies or weaken your enemies, and attack the enemy HQ to achieve victory.

Manage resources: Every action requires resources. Plan your moves to avoid running out of resources at the crucial moment.

How to win?

Destroy your opponent's HQ or force them to exhaust all their deck.

Each HQ has unique abilities that define your playstyle. Choose a strategy: Attack directly with a Shock HQ, defend your position with a Rear HQ, or balance your strategy with a Combat HQ.

Key Features:

• Historical Atmosphere: Realistic World War II tanks;

• Deep Strategy: Combine maps, HQ abilities, and positioning to achieve victory;

• Variety: Three nations (Germany, USA, and USSR), dozens of HQs, and hundreds of maps to experiment with;

• Gameplay: Battle other players, the AI, in historical campaigns, raids, or random battles;

• The game is easy to learn, yet offers a huge variety of mechanics.

The game is being developed by an enthusiast with a great love for military history and tactical games. I am constantly improving the game based on community reviews.

Thank you for your attention
short_desc: Tank General, a World War II-themed card game with unique gameplay mechanics, deep tactical combat, and an easy entry level. Build your deck, battle against humans and AI, complete campaigns and raids, and explore new cards and headquarters!
